parameters.name: X-Bridge-Completion-Recovery
parameters.description: Opt-in inference retention requires Idempotency-Key fbr1_ followed by 32 lowercase hex digits. Recover through exact authenticated GET only; never automatically resubmit.

parameters.name: X-Bridge-Image-Revision
parameters.description: Optional for image input: requires current verified configuration at first admission; included in the idempotency fingerprint. Text requests are unchanged.

200.description: Validated completion JSON or buffered OpenAI SSE. Keepalive comments precede the final chunks; data: [DONE] ends the stream.

X-Bridge-Job-Id.description: Durable job ID for console and recovery

202.description: bridge.background=true: legacy Job, or opt-in original job/request identity only

X-Bridge-Job-Id.description: Durable job ID for console and recovery

429.description: Admission bound or subscription limit. A paused admitted job is retained.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a known provider reset
